label: Nothing has actuality except insofar as it is: whatever is in act in…, from meinongian refutation
description: Whatever is in act in some respect is in act as to being (the ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3 reading), from the conclusion of NO-ACTUALITY-WITHOUT-BEING-FROM-PERFECTION (nothing is in act in a respect without being, on the same InAct and esse) and excluded middle: if x is in act in r and not in act as to esse, the Meinongian rival would be witnessed. This is a second derivation of the route premise from the refutation's own premises (STMT-PERFECT-INSOFAR-AS-IN-ACT, STMT-PERFECT-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING), both still OPEN; it does not establish the route premise and does not attribute the conclusion to a new source.
